map.alt: Map of Excavation Site: Wetlands in WoW Forever, with where each boss stands

abilities.name: A large health pool
abilities.description: Nothing special seen in the fight: he hits and has a lot of health. He roams the marsh at the start among elite crocolisks, so clear them first or pull him away from them.

trigger.text: Kill the raptor matriarch in the tall grass. A wave of raptors comes when she dies, and Shadetooth runs in once they are dead.

abilities.name: Raptors in the grass
abilities.description: Small raptors jump out of the grass as you walk through it and make you bleed.

abilities.name: The wave before him
abilities.description: Kill every raptor of the wave before he arrives. One group wiped on its first try with Shadetooth and several raptors on it at once.

abilities.name: Fear
abilities.description: The tank is feared several times in this fight. A shaman's Tremor Totem helps.

abilities.name: The Dragonmaw camp
abilities.description: He stands in a Dragonmaw camp. Its groups pull apart easily: take them one at a time first. The fight itself is short, nothing special seen yet.

trigger.text: He stands still at the end of the spider trail. Click the small panel next to him to wake him.

abilities.name: Threat reset
abilities.description: He drops his threat and changes target during the fight. Damage dealers, slow down when the tank loses him. Tank, take him back at once.
